summary: All three round 1 findings have been addressed cleanly with no regressions or new issues. SecurityConfigTest::csrfProtection_excludesWebhookPath_keepsApiPathProtected now chains isNotEqualTo(403).isLessThan(500) on a typed int, so a 5xx from a misconfigured controller fails the assertion instead of silently passing. SecurityConfigTest::csrfCookie_writtenOnSafeVerbRequest has been deduplicated — GET /health is now invoked exactly once, and the higher-level matcher cookie().exists("XSRF-TOKEN") is folded into the same chain alongside the typed Cookie extraction and value-not-blank check. GlobalErrorHandlerTest now carries a header comment explicitly mapping the granular appException_*/handleResponseStatus_*/throwable_* methods back to the umbrella TDD-anchor name 'handleAppException_handleResponseStatus_handleThrowable_unchanged' for grep-based anchor-traceability automation. Litmus tests pass on both reworked SecurityConfigTest scenarios (regressing CsrfFilter to challenge /webhooks → 403 fails; regressing controller chain to 500 → fails). No new tests added, no test deleted, no servlet/reactive stack contamination introduced.
